title: You built this shelf
hook: Would assembling the item change your asking price for it?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate production effort from the resulting item's externally matched quality.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate production effort from the resulting item's externally matched quality.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy shelf uses €20 of materials and two hours valued at €10 per hour. What is its full resource cost? Toy inputs A=[20, 2, 10]; B=[40, 0, 10].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[40, 20, 20], [40, 40, 0]]. Labels: Total cost €, Materials €, Labor €.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Counting assembly effort gives the toy shelf a resource cost comparable to a ready-made purchase. A subjective valuation premium for building it yourself would be an additional measured preference, not a consequence of this cost identity.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Materials €=40, Hours=0, €/hour=10. What is Total cost €? Answer: 40.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Materials €=40, Hours=0, €/hour=10. What is Total cost €?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 40. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: People value furniture they assembled themselves more than identical pre-built items, the "IKEA effect" (Norton, Mochon & Ariely, 2012).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate production effort from the resulting item's externally matched quality.
